# BelStekloExpert

BelStekloExpert is an auto glass repair and replacement service in Minsk, Belarus.
The workshop opened in 2025. Its technicians have 18 years of practical auto glass installation experience.

## Services

- Windshield replacement
- Side glass replacement
- Rear glass replacement
- Chip repair
- Crack repair
- Mobile service in Minsk when conditions allow safe installation
- Auto glass selection by VIN, photo, or glass marking
- Model-based online estimate with immediate indicative price in Belarusian rubles
- VIN request for manual precise selection by a specialist
- Services for passenger cars, Tesla, minibuses, passenger transport, trucks, special machinery, excavators, cranes, fleets, taxi, delivery, body shops, and service stations

## Pricing Signals

- Windshield replacement: from 100 Belarusian rubles
- Side or rear glass replacement: from 80 Belarusian rubles
- Chip repair: from 40 Belarusian rubles
- Crack repair: from 35 Belarusian rubles

Final price depends on make, model, year, glass type, heating, camera, rain sensor, ADAS options, molding, consumables, availability, and installation conditions.

## Positioning

BelStekloExpert focuses on careful auto glass selection and installation: VIN-based matching, clear pricing before booking, clean interior protection, work with sensors/camera/heating, and warranty for seam tightness.
The positioning is calm and practical: precise selection first, then careful installation.
